history.body: Hi, I came across your property ad. I’m comparing renting and buying at the moment.

That’s a sensible comparison. Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony—worth considering if having your own space and flexibility matters to you. Are you mainly comparing monthly affordability, or the longer-term benefits of owning?
Mostly the monthly affordability. I haven’t worked out what I’d be comfortable with yet, so I’m just comparing for now.

That’s fair—you don’t need to have a budget figured out yet. One concrete monthly cost to compare: Type A is 900 sq. ft., so maintenance at RM0.18 psf works out to about RM162/month, inclusive of sinking fund. Selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use, rather than being charged as the same fixed clubhouse cost regardless of use. It’s just one part of the picture; loan repayments and other costs depend on the unit and financing, but this gives you a useful starting point against rent.
